Location: West Africa
Description:

An Assistant Mooring Master is sought for operations on oil tankers in West Africa. The contract offers a rotation of 2 months on followed by 2 months off, with a daily salary ranging from 300 to 350 USD. This role requires a valid STCW II/2 Certificate of Competency (Chief Mate or Master Mariner) and a minimum of 3 years of experience onboard oil tankers, preferably in a leadership position such as Chief Officer or Master Mariner. Experience with crude oil loading and offshore marine terminal operations is essential.
